svg.title: Auditing 346 episodes is not the same as authorising closures
svg.desc: Of 346 episodes, 339 have a complete three-year pre-event window and 323 have five. The classification contains 266 with no contradictory signal, 15 continuity candidates, 35 unresolved alerts and 30 right-censored episodes. There are 45 post-event alerts and zero institutional confirmations; automated processing supports observation only.
